test_title: PYST 03: SSC Stenographer 2025: English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 06 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Rearrange the parts of this sentence:

(A) despite poor rainfall

(B) the farmers

(C) managed to harvest

(D) a good crop
solution:
The correct answer is **Option (3)** i.e. **BACD**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The sentence begins with the subject "**the farmers**," which is correctly indicated by **part (B)**.
 
• The next part "**despite poor rainfall**" (A) provides the context for the farmers' actions.
 
• This is followed by "**managed to harvest**" (C), which describes what the farmers did.
 
• The sentence ends with "**a good crop**" (D), completing the thought.

Therefore, the correct answer is **BACD.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **Option 1 (BDAC):** This arrangement creates an incorrect sequence as "despite poor rainfall" (A) cannot follow "the farmers" (B) directly without context.
 
• **Option 2 (BADC):** This option places "a good crop" (D) before "managed to harvest" (C), disrupting the logical flow of the sentence.
 
• **Option 4 (CBAD):** This option starts with "managed to harvest" (C), which is incomplete without the preceding subject and context.
